description: Search the Official Code of Georgia Annotated BY TOPIC or keyword rather than citation — "security deposit", "concealed carry", "DUI per se limit", "homicide". Full-text search over the statutory text and catchlines; returns ranked sections with their citations and a highlighted snippet so you can call ga_code_section for the full text of one. Pass "headings_only": true to match only chapter/article headings and catchlines rather than body text. Keyless.

headings_only.description: Match only headings/catchlines, not body text. Default false.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "security deposit return".

name: ga_code_search
title: Ga Code Search
